(Currently amended) Claim 13: A computer-executable software product, transmitted as an information signal, for causing a computer to implement the steps of the method of claim 1.

(Currently amended) Claim 23: A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a processing unit configured to obtain combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a processing unit configured to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

(Currently amended) Claim 24: The system of claim 23, further comprising a processing unit configured to increase the quality of said matched collection. 

(Currently amended) Claim 25: The system of claim 23, further comprising a processing unit configured to provide additional trading functionality.
